summary.text: Robb Tucker is a Republican member of the Nevada County Board of Supervisors, elected in 2024, and a former president and CEO of a family business that owned a mobile home community. According to his campaign, he was raised in southern Nevada County and holds degrees from Pepperdine University and Wheaton College Graduate School. He is running on local control, public safety, small business and fiscal discipline.

paragraphs.text: According to his campaign website, was born and raised in Nevada County and he and his wife are raising their children there; his campaign says he is the grandson and son of retired U.S. Air Force pilots.
According to his campaign, earned a bachelor's degree in business administration from Pepperdine University and a master's degree from Wheaton College Graduate School.
According to his campaign, served as president and CEO of a closely held family business that owned the Forest Springs Mobilehome Community until selling the business in 2020.

Elected to the Nevada County Board of Supervisors in 2024; his campaign says he has focused on public safety, support for small businesses and jobs, and a balance of growth, development and agriculture.

Serves on the Nevada County Board of Supervisors, where his campaign says he has worked to secure funding for shelters, mental health care, and public safety equipment despite mismatched state and federal funding streams.

According to his campaign, he holds a commercial pilot license with multi-engine and instrument ratings, has coached youth and prep sports for decades, is active in local schools and his church, and lives in South Nevada County with his wife, Kristy, and their three children.

Advanced from the June 2, 2026 top-two primary to the November 3 general election as a Republican candidate for California's 3rd District; he has not completed Ballotpedia's 2026 Candidate Connection survey.
